title: A Localized Enantioselective Catalytic Site on Short DNA Sequences and their Amphiphiles
authors: Jun Guo; Danyu Wang; Evangelia Pantatosaki; Huihui Kuang; George Papadopoulos; Michael Tsapatsis; Efrosini Kokkoli
one_liner_zh: 该文研究短DNA序列上铜配合物催化对映选择性Diels-Alder反应，虽涉及DNA结合与分子模拟，但核心是人工金属酶催化而非TF-DNA转录因子结合机制，方法上仅用分子模拟辅助解释，与课题聚焦的TF-DNA互作建模关联较弱。
abstract: A DNA-based artificial metalloenzyme (ArM) consisting of copper (II) complex of 4,4’-dimethyl-2,2’-bipyridine (dmbipy-Cu) bound to double-stranded DNA (dsDNA) as short as 8 base pairs with only two contiguous central G•C pairs (G for guanine and C for cytosine), catalyzes highly enantioselective Diels-Alder reaction in water. Molecular simulations indicate that these minimal sequences provide a single site where dmbipy-Cu is groove-bound and able to function as an enantioselective catalyst. Enantioselective preference inverses when D-DNA is replaced with L-DNA. When the DNA is conjugated to a hydrophobic tail, the obtained ArMs exhibit enantioselective performance in a methanol-water mixture superior to that of non-amphiphilic dsDNA, and dsDNA-amphiphiles with more complex G•C-rich sequences.
abstract_zh: 一种基于DNA的人工金属酶（ArM），由4,4’-二甲基-2,2’-联吡啶的铜(II)配合物（dmbipy-Cu）结合于双链DNA（dsDNA）上构成，该dsDNA短至8个碱基对，仅含两个连续的中央G•C配对（G代表鸟嘌呤，C代表胞嘧啶），能在水中催化高对映选择性的Diels-Alder反应。分子模拟表明，这些最小序列提供了一个单一结合位点，dmbipy-Cu在此处沟槽结合并能作为对映选择性催化剂发挥作用。当D-DNA被L-DNA替代时，对映选择性偏好发生反转。当DNA与疏水尾部结合时，所得ArMs在甲醇-水混合物中表现出的对映选择性性能优于非两亲性dsDNA，以及具有更复杂G•C富集序列的dsDNA-两亲物。
